hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Middle East, bordering the Arabian Sea, Gulf of Oman, and Persian Gulf, between Yemen and the UAE || central desert plain, rugged mountains in north and south || consists of Oman proper and two northern exclaves, Musandam and Al Madhah; the former is a peninsula that occupies a strategic location adjacent to the Strait of Hormuz || Resources: petroleum, copper, asbestos, some marble, limestone, chromium, gypsum, natural gas || Exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, natural gas, semi-finished iron, fertilizers (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: central desert plain, rugged mountains in north and south || Middle East, bordering the Arabian Sea, Gulf of Oman, and Persian Gulf, between Yemen and the UAE

climate.excerpt: dry desert; hot, humid along coast; hot, dry interior; strong southwest summer monsoon (May to September) in far south || summer winds often raise large sandstorms and dust storms in interior; periodic droughts

economy.excerpt: high-income, oil-based economy; large welfare system; growing government debt; citizenship-based labor force growth policy; US free trade agreement; diversifying portfolio; high female labor force participation || Exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, natural gas, semi-finished iron, fertilizers (2023) || Industries: crude oil production and refining, natural and liquefied natural gas production; construction, cement, copper, steel, chemicals, optic fiber
